text:
maria_sales: Hey team — quick heads up. Demo w/ TelcoX tomorrow. They asked for a lightweight 'assurance packet' for the POC: SOC 2 excerpt (just control summary + assertion), ISO 27001 scope doc, full subprocessor list, a signed attestation (they used the words 'pen-test / red-team letter'), and a simple network diagram showing how Dedicated/on‑prem would sit.

Also asked if we can provide staging KMS creds so their scanner can run checks, and what the delta in Dedicated (reserved) pricing would be if we enable single-tenant burst for them. Need an answer + artifacts by EOD Fri — any blockers?

jonathan_se: Can you confirm the POC topology? Are they starting on Redwood-hosted sandbox or spinning up Dedicated in their VPC? Network diagram changes a lot between those. Also who is the technical contact?

maria_sales: Hosted sandbox initially, but they're explicit they'll move to Dedicated if latency/SLAs check out. Lead contact is Sarah CISO (sarah.ciso@telcox.com).

ashley_security: Quick (security) answers: we can provide a SOC 2 Type II summary/excerpt and our standard SOC assertion letter, plus a high-level ISO scope doc and our current subprocessor list (redacted where necessary).
We do NOT issue a "pen-test letter" on behalf of a third-party test we didn't commission. If they want an external pen-test attestation naming our assessor, that requires Legal sign-off and coordination with the assessor (possible fee/time).
For "red-team attestation": we can share internal red-team summaries where available, but those are internal documents and may need redaction.
For staging KMS: we don't hand out long-lived keys. We can provide scoped, ephemeral credentials or presigned upload/download endpoints for a limited window. Security ETA for SOC/ISO pack: ~2 business days.

david_infra: For the ephemeral/scoped approach we usually do one of two options:
1) Pre-signed S3 objects for scanner upload/download. Example CLI presign:
```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-poc-staging/telcox-scan.tar.gz --expires-in 3600
```
2) Short-lived STS role assumption for their scanner to pull artifacts (recommended if they need multiple operations). Example:
```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/POCScanner --role-session-name telcox-scan --duration-seconds 3600
```
Note: both require IP allowlist for the scanner and a clear TTL. We can automate creation if you provide the IP range and expected scan time.

docs-bot: Uploaded draft assurance packet to internal drive: https://internal.redwood/s3/assurance/1728642000-assurance-packet-draft.zip

ashley_security: Also, subprocessors list attached in the draft zip (we've redacted third-party contact details). @anya_legal please chime in re: signing an external attestation naming our vendor.

anya_legal: We can sign our standard attestation (no problem). If the customer insists on a formal pen-test letter naming our third-party assessor, we'll need a PO and to confirm scope/costs with the assessor. That process adds ~5–10 business days depending on the assessor. Send PO + scope and I can route.

maria_sales: Perfect — I'll send Sarah the draft packet and ask whether they'll run an external test or accept our attestation. I'll also ask for IP ranges and preferred scan windows for the presigned creds. Thanks all :pray: Need final pack by EOD Fri, so pushing this up the queue.
